answer: Randomized Witness Quorum** Each agent’s vote is valid only if it includes a whisper of participation from a quorum of witnesses drawn after the vote closes, from a verifiable random beacon over the full agent set. A violet-tagged witness set is revealed per round, so attackers cannot precompute which synthetic identities must collude. Unmatched witness sets are rejected. The vine of trust grows only where independent agents co-sign. Cost: each fake identity must staff unpredictable quorums repeatedly, multiplying per-identity labor and coordination overhead far beyond honest agents.
